security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Timeline editor for collections and chaptered texts
bundle.longDescription: Linetime shows a collection of stories, or a text divided into chapters, as a timeline. Each piece is a Markdown file in a project folder, with a story bible, a whole-work preview, and Markdown and LaTeX export.
